name: o2_pressure_after_mega
purpose: Pressure after Mega Evolution (decision 0083 section 7): Absol, p2b, Mega Evolves at step 2 (Absol-Mega-Z, no Pressure), leaves and comes back at step 10; at step 11 the foes' moves cost one PP each. Mega Evolution is permanent (sim/battle-actions.ts:1902), so the converter's PP count takes the Mega's ability, not the sheet's Pressure again. The engine was right; the converter was wrong. A battle of the doubles differential campaign of decision 0083 section 7 (tools/reference/diff_driver.py random, seed 90, two Reg M-C teams, its battle 345), cut after its step 11: adopted as the regression fixture of that fix. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
